title: Mayor orders probe into illegal Pogo operations in Zamboanga Sibugay

blocks.text: PAGADIAN CITY, Zamboanga del Sur — Local authorities in Alicia town, Zamboanga Sibugay have launched an investigation into unauthorized business activities following the arrest of over 200 foreign nationals in twin raids against hubs of illegal Philippine Offshore Gaming Operations (Pogo) in the province. In a statement released on social media Saturday, Alicia Mayor Ardin Musa declared that the municipal government “does not condone the presence, establishment, or proliferation” of Pogo operations within its administrative jurisdiction. Musa emphasized that economic growth will not be pursued at the cost of public safety and moral integrity. READ: ‘Largest Pogo bust’: 244 nabbed in […]...
